useCase.name: Let a guardian who has arrived tell the office they are here to collect, by confirming a prompt rather than going to the desk

intent.name: geofence.set
intent.summary: Set the branch's pickup boundary — its centre and radius — and the hours within which a pickup prompt may appear.
routesHere: set the pickup boundary to 150 metres around the main gate, 12:30 to 14:30

routesHere.text: pickup ka geofence 200 meter kar do, 1 se 3 baje tak
routesHere.gloss: set the pickup geofence to 200 metres, from 1 to 3 o'clock

routesHere.text: pickup window 12:45 se 2 baje tak kar do

routesHere: change the pickup radius to 100 metres

request.gloss: let the prompt appear at any time

routesElsewhere.note: A window is required. A prompt that can appear at any hour appears at the wrong ones (BR-1).

request.text: geofence mein aate hi request khud raise ho jaye
request.gloss: raise the request automatically as soon as they enter the geofence

routesElsewhere.note: Presence alone raises nothing; only the guardian's confirmation does (BR-4).

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. A window that closes before it opens is not saved.
plan.atomicity: One write: the branch's boundary and window, replacing any set before (BR-1).

operations.name: geofence.set
operations.idempotencyKey: branch_id, since a branch has one boundary
operations.purpose: Set the branch's pickup boundary and window.

parameters.name: centre
parameters.notes: The centre of the boundary (BR-1). The School Admin's own point — never estimated from an address.

parameters.name: radius_metres
parameters.notes: In metres (BR-1). A phone's location can be out by a hundred metres in a built-up area, and a radius set too wide prompts every guardian driving past (OQ-1).

parameters.name: window_opens
parameters.notes: 24-hour time from which a prompt may appear.

parameters.name: window_closes
parameters.notes: 24-hour time after which no prompt appears. After it opens (E2).

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

returns.description: The boundary and window as now set.

fields.name: window_opens
fields.description: From when a prompt may appear.

errors.meaning: The window closes before it opens.

planningRules.rule: Never choose the centre, the radius or the hours. They decide who is prompted and when, and they are the School Admin's to state (BR-1).

Say what a wide radius does. Location can be out by a hundred metres in a built-up area, nothing says how accurate the boundary must be, and too wide a radius prompts every guardian driving past (OQ-1).

reversal.statement: A boundary is set again rather than withdrawn. Nothing keeps the earlier values for it, so they are read first with geofence.read where they may be wanted back.

request.text: pickup geofence 150 meter kar do, 12:30 se 2:30 tak
request.gloss: set the pickup geofence to 150 metres, 12:30 to 2:30

resolvedPlans.context: School Admin, Johar Town. A boundary is already set, centred on the main gate.

inputs.centre: $request.centre → the main gate, as they confirm when asked

resolvedPlans.outcome: They named no centre, so confirm the main gate is still it rather than assuming. Then set: 150 metres, 12:30 to 14:30.

intent.name: geofence.read
intent.summary: The branch's pickup boundary and window, as set.

routesHere.text: pickup ka time kya set hai?
routesHere.gloss: what time is set for pickup?
how many metres is the geofence?

operations.name: geofence.read
operations.purpose: Return the branch's pickup boundary and window.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

fields.name: is_set
fields.description: False where no boundary is set — then no prompt can appear at all (E1).

fields.name: window_opens
fields.description: From when a prompt may appear.

errors.meaning: No boundary is set for the branch.
errors.note: Reported as the reason no guardian at this branch is prompted.

planningRules.rule: Where none is set, say that no guardian at this branch can be prompted at all (E1, AC-10).

reversal.statement: A read changes nothing, so there is nothing to reverse.

request.text: pickup ka time kya set hai?
request.gloss: what time is set for pickup?

resolvedPlans.outcome: 12:30 to 14:30, within 150 metres of the main gate.

intent.name: pickup.request.geofence.confirm
intent.summary: A guardian who has arrived confirms they are here to collect, and which of their children. The confirmation raises the request; being nearby raises nothing.

routesHere.text: main school pohanch gaya hoon, Ayesha ko lene aaya hoon
routesHere.gloss: I have reached the school, I have come to collect Ayesha

routesHere.text: haan, dono bachon ko lene aayi hoon
routesHere.gloss: yes, I've come to collect both children

routesHere: yes, I'm here to collect Ali

routesHere.text: gate pe hoon, Hamza ko bhej dein
routesHere.gloss: I'm at the gate, send Hamza

request.text: main ghar se nikal raha hoon, Ayesha ko tayyar rakhein
request.gloss: I'm leaving home, keep Ayesha ready

routesElsewhere.note: A request is raised by a guardian who is there: inside the boundary during the window, and then confirming (BR-2, BR-4).

request.text: mere paas location nahi hai, gate pe barcode hai
request.gloss: I don't have location on, there's a barcode at the gate

routesElsewhere.note: The gate barcode is the route for a guardian with no card and no location. It is scanned by the portal's camera and never travels in a plan.

request.text: chacha ko bhej raha hoon, unka naam likh lein
request.gloss: I'm sending the uncle, write his name down

routesElsewhere.note: Nothing in this module records who collects a child. The request shows how it was raised and identifies nobody (BR-7).

request.text: request cancel kar dein, main nahi aa saka
request.gloss: cancel the request, I couldn't come

steps.note: One step. **The words confirm; the device locates.** The request goes into the pickup queue (BR-6).

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. No boundary, a device outside it or outside the window, no child named, or a request already open raises nothing — and an open one is shown instead of a second being raised.
plan.atomicity: One write: the request, carrying the guardian, the children named, the time and the branch, into the pickup queue (BR-6). It identifies nobody (BR-7), and it is never deleted (BR-8).

operations.name: pickup.request.geofence.confirm
operations.idempotencyKey: guardian_id + the day, since a guardian holds one open request at a time (BR-5)
operations.purpose: Raise a pickup request on a guardian's confirmation, from inside the branch's boundary during the window.

parameters.name: student_ids

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. None of this guardian's children at this branch matches (E4).
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the guardian's children at this branch with their classes.

parameters.notes: Which of the guardian's own children at this branch they are collecting — asked, never assumed to be all of them (BR-3). A child not enrolled at this branch is not offered (BR-9, E4).

parameters.name: guardian_id
parameters.notes: The guardian's own portal account. Never from the request — a guardian raises a request only as themselves, for their own children.

parameters.name: device_location
parameters.notes: Where the guardian's phone reports it is, supplied by the portal — **never from the request**. Saying "I'm at the gate" is a confirmation, not a location (BR-2). Read only while the portal is open, as modelled (OQ-2).

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: The branch whose boundary the device is inside. Never from the request (branch-scope).

returns.description: The request, and where it went.

fields.name: identifies_nobody
fields.description: True, always. The request carries the guardian's portal account, the children, the time and the branch — not who will take the child (BR-7).

errors.meaning: No boundary is set for the branch.
The device is not inside the boundary, it is outside the window, or location permission has not been granted.
errors.note: On the screen there is simply no prompt (A4, A5). The assistant path can be asked anyway, and the use case writes no exception for that.

errors.meaning: The guardian confirmed with no child named.
The guardian already holds an open request.
errors.written: The refused confirmation, in the audit log.
errors.notWritten: No second request. The existing one is returned and shown.

planningRules.rule: Raise only on the guardian's own confirmation that they are here to collect. Presence raises nothing, and a guardian passing the school has raised nothing (BR-4, A1, E6).
Never assume which children. Ask, where there is more than one at the school — a guardian collecting one child has not asked for all three (BR-3, AC-4).
Location comes from the device, never from the words. "I'm at the gate" is a confirmation, not a location; the portal supplies where the phone is (BR-2).
Where one is already open, show it rather than raising another (BR-5, E7).
Never take a collector's name. The request identifies nobody — it is a means of raising a request, not a check on a person (BR-7).

reversal.statement: The guardian cancels it while it is in the queue. It stays on the record (BR-8).

request.text: gate pe pohanch gayi hoon, Ayesha ko lene aayi hoon
request.gloss: I've reached the gate, I've come for Ayesha

resolvedPlans.context: Guardian, three children at Johar Town. Phone inside the boundary at 13:40; window 12:30–14:30.

steps.note: One child named, one child raised (PR-2).

resolvedPlans.outcome: Raised for Ayesha alone — the other two are not assumed. It is in the pickup queue. Say that it identifies nobody, and that it can be cancelled while it waits.

request.text: main aa gaya hoon, Hamza ko bhej dein

resolvedPlans.context: Guardian. A request for Hamza raised ten minutes ago is still open.
resolvedPlans.outcome: No second request. Show the open one — raised ten minutes ago, and where it stands.

intent.name: pickup.request.cancel
intent.summary: Cancel your own pickup request while it waits in the queue. It stays on the record.

routesHere.text: request cancel kar dein, main nahi aa saka
routesHere.gloss: cancel the request, I couldn't come

routesHere.text: Ayesha ki pickup request wapas le lein, driver shaam ko le jayega
routesHere.gloss: withdraw Ayesha's pickup request, the driver will take her in the evening

routesElsewhere.note: A request is never deleted. One cancelled stays on the record (BR-8, E8).

request.text: bachi to chali gayi, ab request cancel karo
request.gloss: the child has already left, cancel the request now

routesElsewhere.note: A completed request is the record that the child left, and it is final (UC-29-07).

plan.atomicity: One state change: in the queue to cancelled. Nothing is deleted (BR-8).

operations.name: pickup.request.cancel
operations.idempotencyKey: request_id, since a request is cancelled once
operations.purpose: Cancel a guardian's own request while it is in the queue.

parameters.name: request_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. None of this guardian's open requests matches.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming their open requests with the children and times raised.

parameters.notes: The guardian's own open request, named by the child.

parameters.name: guardian_id
parameters.notes: The guardian's own portal account. Never from the request — a guardian raises a request only as themselves, for their own children.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

fields.name: status
fields.description: Cancelled. Terminal, and on the record (BR-8).

errors.meaning: The request is no longer in the queue — completed, not collected, or already cancelled.
errors.note: The lifecycle cancels only from the queue. The use case describes cancelling in the lifecycle alone, with no flow step and no exception.

planningRules.rule: Say it stays on the record. A request is never deleted; cancelled is a state, not a removal (BR-8, E8).

reversal.statement: A cancelled request is final. A guardian who comes after all raises a new one.

request.text: Ayesha ki pickup request cancel kar dein, driver shaam ko le jayega
request.gloss: cancel Ayesha's pickup request, the driver will take her in the evening

resolvedPlans.context: Guardian. Ayesha's request in the queue for four minutes.

intent.name: pickup.requests.mine.read
intent.summary: Where your own pickup requests stand.

routesHere.text: meri pickup request ka kya bana?
routesHere.gloss: what happened to my pickup request?

routesHere.text: Ayesha ko gate pe bhej diya?
routesHere.gloss: has Ayesha been sent to the gate?

routesHere: is my pickup request still open?

routesElsewhere.note: A guardian sees their own requests only.

operations.name: pickup.requests.mine.read
operations.purpose: List the guardian's own pickup requests.

parameters.name: guardian_id
parameters.notes: The guardian's own portal account. Never from the request — a guardian raises a request only as themselves, for their own children.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

fields.name: requests
fields.description: Children, how raised, time raised, and status (BR-6).

fields.name: open_request
fields.description: The one still open, where there is one.

planningRules.rule: Report the state as recorded. Nothing here says who is on the way to the gate, and nothing should (BR-7).
Where one is open, say that a second confirmation will be refused and this one shown instead (BR-5).

reversal.statement: A read changes nothing, so there is nothing to reverse.

request.text: meri pickup request ka kya bana?
request.gloss: what happened to my pickup request?

resolvedPlans.context: Guardian. One request, in the queue for six minutes.
resolvedPlans.outcome: It is in the queue, raised six minutes ago.
